prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: clean portrait artwork for an ARC Prize 2026 competitor card, 5:7 portrait, 1500x2100 or larger. Create an original heroic cyberpunk illustration celebrating Chan Kha Vu's ARC-AGI-2 top-ten team run and his history of machine-learning competitions. IMAGE 1 is his own Kaggle profile photo: this is the sole identity reference. Preserve its distinguishing short dark hair, visible eyes, black outer jacket and especially the striking white face covering with its dense red-and-black embroidered floral motif and white Ukrainian embroidered shirt with red/black trim; his nose and mouth MUST stay fully covered, because the source image does not reveal them. Do not invent an unmasked face, age details or a borrowed likeness. Make him a dignified, friendly adult competitor, a confident illustrated maker in a tailored deep charcoal cyber jacket with elegant red-and-black Ukrainian embroidery and subtle luminous blue-and-gold accents, a few carefully integrated GPU circuitry pieces. Three-quarter head-to-waist view, one hand adjusting a vivid multicolored ARC puzzle tile and the other resting on a GPU-equipped workbench; a rising track of luminous puzzle tiles suggests an exciting competitive climb, without any numbers. Background is a distinctive nighttime competition workshop with warm lighting and a small sunflower motif, an original respectful tribute derived from his own public self-description, not official insignia. IMAGE 2 supplies the editorial card illustration style and lighting ONLY, not character identity, clothing, face or background. Smooth flattering painted graphic-novel realism, detailed but cohesive, NO literal pasted photo, no anime. Artwork full bleed no frame or text; space at top and bottom for later card typography. Place eyes high in the upper-middle with head and hands away from edges, darker simpler lower quarter for overlays. No name, words, numbers, scores, medals, logos, banners, flags or watermark; no other humans, no weapons, no national conflict imagery, no claim of actual competition method. The face covering is integral and remains closed.
